scoring_justification: Recomputing the full MD simulation in the verifier is infeasible; we compare the agent's reported metrics against paper gold with tolerances and structural energy ratio checks.

outputs.description: Scored artifact containing detaching time, detaching velocity, and Cu-Cu and C-Cu interaction energy changes for the flat graphene (G) and pillared graphene (PG) systems.

output_contract.notes: Only the two systems (G and PG) with H=5 Å are required; parametric sweeps and other substrates are excluded.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference metric values for t_d, v_d range, and energy ratio thresholds derived from paper claims.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reported detaching time (41 ps), v_d range (50-150 m/s) inferred from Figure 4, and relative energy difference assertions (large ΔE_Cu-Cu, small E_C-Cu).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper text and figures; tolerances set to allow toolchain variation.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly from the paper's published results.
